newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends higher, outlook still weak.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends higher, outlook still weak.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures settled firmer in what traders viewed as a temporary consolidation to recent losses.
Amid a continued dearth of physical offtake, ample supplies and a bearish technical outlook, March futures are seen continuing to descend toward 10.00 cents a lb.
The spot month closed up 0.05 cent at 10.35 cents, traded 10.37 to 10.22. May gained 0.06 to settle at 10.51, while the back months finished 0.05 and 0.07 higher.

Prices opened lower on expecations for weakness following Monday's close at the day's low. But local shortcovering and trade buying lifted prices over unchanged on the reopen, where they lingered throughout the afternoon, dealers said.
Firm support was placed at 10.21, where a double bottom has formed on the charts. Under that level, sell stops may be triggered, traders said.
Speculative selling at the highs is likely to keep pressure on the market. Resistance was seen at 10.40 cents and then 10.50 cents in March.
